step_1.subject: Central FL charter campus cabling scope / {{company_name}} inquiry
step_1.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

The IT Director at a public charter campus in the Volusia / Central FL corridor just sent over their Category 2 scope for Cat6A drops and WiFi switches.

The deployment calls for plenum cable runs, patch panels, PoE switching, and indoor/outdoor Access Point mounting across campus (~90 AP units).

They asked for 1 or 2 qualified local cabling teams with an active SPIN to review the schedule before the allowable contract date locks.

Before I route their BoQ, wanted to check: do your technicians have open bench capacity in Central FL this quarter?

Pandu

step_2.subject: Re: Central FL charter campus cabling scope / {{company_name}} inquiry
step_2.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Quick bump on this — wanted to make sure this didn't get buried before I route this campus scope over to another local cabling contractor in Central FL.

Pandu
